docker run --rm --network=none 'us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/nfl-predictions-503414/nfl-dfs/nfl-dfs:r6-current-bank-crossed-screen-8ae6c22a-v2' \
  /usr/local/bin/python3.11 -I -c \
  "import os; from pathlib import Path; import nfl_dfs; from nfl_dfs.research import corpus_r6_current_bank_crossed_screen_contract_v1 as c, corpus_r6_current_bank_crossed_screen_task_manifest_v1 as m; root=Path('/app'); assert Path(nfl_dfs.__file__).resolve() == root/'src/nfl_dfs/__init__.py'; assert Path(c.__file__).resolve() == root/'src/nfl_dfs/research/corpus_r6_current_bank_crossed_screen_contract_v1.py'; assert Path(m.__file__).resolve() == root/'src/nfl_dfs/research/corpus_r6_current_bank_crossed_screen_task_manifest_v1.py'; assert 'PYTHONPATH' not in os.environ and 'PYTHONHOME' not in os.environ; assert (root/c.CONTRACT_REPORT_PATH).is_file(); assert m.canonical_dispatcher_process_spec_v1()['command'] == ['/usr/local/bin/python3.11','-I','/app/scripts/run_corpus_r6_current_bank_crossed_screen_task_dispatcher_v1.py']; specs=m.canonical_bootstrap_process_specs_v1(); assert len(specs) == len(c.PROCESS_ROLES); assert all(component['entrypoint_path'].startswith('/app/') for spec in specs for component in spec['process_chain'])"
set +e
help_output="$(docker run --rm --network=none 'us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/nfl-predictions-503414/nfl-dfs/nfl-dfs:r6-current-bank-crossed-screen-8ae6c22a-v2' \
  /usr/local/bin/python3.11 -I \
  /app/scripts/run_corpus_r6_current_bank_crossed_screen_task_dispatcher_v1.py \
  --help 2>&1)"
help_status="$?"
closed_output="$(docker run --rm --network=none 'us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/nfl-predictions-503414/nfl-dfs/nfl-dfs:r6-current-bank-crossed-screen-8ae6c22a-v2' 2>&1)"
closed_status="$?"
set -e
test "$help_status" -eq 1
test "$closed_status" -eq 1
case "$help_output" in
  *"task dispatcher failed closed: dispatcher kernel command token count differs"*) ;;
  *) printf '%s\n' "$help_output" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "$closed_output" in
  *"task dispatcher failed closed: dispatcher requires exact R6_CURRENT_BANK_TASK_DISPATCH_ENABLED=1"*) ;;
  *) printf '%s\n' "$closed_output" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
